Package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api

Interface ElectricalModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
ElectricalModel.AcVoltageSource, ElectricalModel.Capacitor, ElectricalModel.ControlledCurrentSource, ElectricalModel.ControlledVoltageSource, ElectricalModel.CurrentSource, ElectricalModel.Diode, ElectricalModel.Inductor, ElectricalModel.Resistor, ElectricalModel.Switch, ElectricalModel.Transformer, ElectricalModel.VoltageSource
public sealed interface ElectricalModel permits ElectricalModel.Resistor, ElectricalModel.Switch, ElectricalModel.VoltageSource, ElectricalModel.CurrentSource, ElectricalModel.AcVoltageSource, ElectricalModel.Capacitor, ElectricalModel.Inductor, ElectricalModel.Diode, ElectricalModel.Transformer, ElectricalModel.ControlledVoltageSource, ElectricalModel.ControlledCurrentSource
Captured electrical parameters supported by API 1.0. Models contain no world callbacks or solver handles. Creation of a new model record is not an electrical timestep. See the package contract for voltage, current, and power orientation.
